## Workload

Daniel Roche completed grading work across 500 sets during 398 rostered hours. This represents a rate of 1.3 sets per hour. The recorded workload provides the basis for the review of grading activity and the current session pattern.

The review notes that the workload was completed within the rostered hours and that the session pattern remains suitable for the work undertaken.

## Quality

A sample of 46 sets was read again as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 69.6 per cent. This result was considered alongside the grading completed by Daniel Roche.

Daniel Roche and Priya Anand agreed to retain the current session pattern. The review was completed by Priya Anand.
